Why precise asset tracking matters
Businesses lose billions each year because they cannot locate tools, inventory or shipments in real time. Digital asset‑tracking systems help prevent losses, optimize workflows and maintain compliance. Traditional solutions rely on GPS, RFID or Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) beacons.
